prediction: Free recursive rollout; no truth updates after context.
long_uncertainty: No calibration claim beyond the prior 9-unit intervals. Neural members and mean are displayed separately.
selection: 180-step validation only; all long test outputs are evaluated after fits are fixed.
sampling_note: Two long, overlapping origins per fresh trajectory plus one reference; dependent origins, not nine independent trajectories.
climate_note: Single-member distribution metrics avoid averaging unrelated chaotic phases.
numerical_limit: Nonfinite states or |state/training_std|>1e6 are explicit numerical failures; no clipping into a plausible range.
